description.value: Legendary Noodle House is a Vietnamese restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, handcrafting noodles in an open kitchen since 1997. The compact interior is decorated with an antique wooden waterwheel at the entrance, Chinese lanterns, dark wood tables and benches imported from China, and wooden screens backlit by turquoise lights. A second location operates on West Broadway, and the English Bay location offers both dine-in and takeout.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 43m; stands (4 spaces) at 44m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 67m; stands (3 spaces) at 70m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 92m. Total: 17 spaces.

Takeout is positively confirmed by 'ORDER PICK UP 自提' and 'ORDER PICK-UP & DELIVERY' links on the website. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; phone 604-669-8551 was sourced from the website only.
OSM tag wheelchair=no indicates the location is not wheelchair accessible.
Website repeatedly renders the brand name as 'LEGENDAY NOODLE' (missing 'R') — appears to be a persistent typo on their own site, not an identity mismatch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly operating in a high-traffic cycling corridor near the English Bay seawall, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags; on-site verification is needed.
